EC3: History of bleeding diathesis [OR] or known coagulopathy [OR] (including heparin-induced thrombocytopenia), or refuses blood transfusions.
EC4: Baseline hemogram with Hb [OR]<10g/dL or PLT count<100,000/μL
EC5: Patients already taking warfarin [OR], cilostazol [OR] or any other type of anti-platelet agents [NOT] except aspirin [OR] and clopidogrel
EC6: Gastrointestinal [OR] or genitourinary bleeding [OR] within the prior 3 months, or major surgery within 2 months.
